## Header 2
### Header 3

This is a [hyperlink](https://www.gloor.fyi).

Inline code `r 2 + 2`.

$$
(\hat{\boldsymbol{\rho}}, \hat{\nu}) = \arg\max_{\boldsymbol{\rho} \in \mathcal{P}_d,\ \nu > 2} \sum_{i=1}^{n} \left[ \log \Gamma\!\left(\tfrac{\nu+d}{2}\right) + (d-1)\log\Gamma\!\left(\tfrac{\nu}{2}\right) - d\log\Gamma\!\left(\tfrac{\nu+1}{2}\right) - \tfrac{1}{2}\log\lvert\boldsymbol{\rho}\rvert - \tfrac{\nu+d}{2}\log\!\left(1 + \tfrac{\mathbf{q}_i^{\top}\boldsymbol{\rho}^{-1}\mathbf{q}_i}{\nu}\right) + \sum_{j=1}^{d}\tfrac{\nu+1}{2}\log\!\left(1 + \tfrac{q_{ij}^2}{\nu}\right) \right]
$$

where $\mathbf{q}_i = \left(t_\nu^{-1}(u_{i1}), \ldots, t_\nu^{-1}(u_{id})\right)^{\top}$, $t_\nu^{-1}$ is the inverse univariate Student-$t$ CDF with $\nu$ degrees of freedom, $\boldsymbol{\rho}$ is the $d \times d$ correlation matrix in the positive-definite cone $\mathcal{P}_d$, and $\Gamma(\cdot)$ is the gamma function.
